title: All-feeds article fetch is stubbed and always returns no articles

evidence.quote: Fetches and processes articles from all enabled feeds

reasoning: The protocol promises that this repository fetches and processes articles from all enabled feeds, but the implementation is a hard-coded stub. Any caller using the main orchestration method will successfully receive an empty list even when feeds exist, causing digest generation to silently skip all content.
reproduction: Create enabled feeds, then call ArticleRepository.fetchAndProcessArticles(); it returns [] without reading feeds or invoking the parser/extractor.
recommendation: Inject or otherwise provide access to the feed repository, fetch enabled feeds, process each feed, and return the combined processed articles. Until implemented, avoid returning a successful empty result for unsupported behavior.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked tests cover digest, feed, and settings repositories only; there is no ArticleRepository test for the all-feeds entrypoint.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add an ArticleRepository test with a fake feed repository and parser proving fetchAndProcessArticles() processes enabled feeds and returns their articles.
minimumFixScope: Modules/Data/Sources/Data/Repositories/ArticleRepository.swift plus the constructor/dependency wiring needed to access enabled feeds.
